# Problem codes: Networks, fleets and automation

Path networks, fleets, workers, motion, batteries and chargers, the investment case and the dispatch plan. The list is generated from the codes' own table; the meaning is the table's sentence for the code.

| Code | Severity | Meaning | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| <span id="e_battery"></span>`E_BATTERY` | error | A fleet's battery has a non-numeric capacity_kwh, a fraction outside 0-1, low &gt;= target, an unknown strategy, or lacks a field its strategy needs. | -- |
| <span id="e_battery_schedule"></span>`E_BATTERY_SCHEDULE` | error | A fleet's battery names a schedule the model does not declare. | [`schedules`](../model-file/schedules.md) |
| <span id="e_calendar_timezone"></span>`E_CALENDAR_TIMEZONE` | error | simulation.calendar names a timezone that is not an IANA name. | [`simulation`](../model-file/simulation.md) |
| <span id="e_charger"></span>`E_CHARGER` | error | A charger has an empty, duplicate or already used name, an unknown node or kind, points &lt; 1, power_kw &lt;= 0, a knee, taper_floor or efficiency outside 0-1, or is a swap station without swap_time. | [`chargers`](../model-file/chargers.md) |
| <span id="e_charger_unknown"></span>`E_CHARGER_UNKNOWN` | error | A fleet's battery names a charger the model does not declare. | [`chargers`](../model-file/chargers.md) |
| <span id="e_dispatch"></span>`E_DISPATCH` | error | The dispatch section is malformed (a missing tag list, a step, horizon or replan_every that does not fit, an unknown terminal or forecast, an unknown field), two flows hold the same grid role, a storage marked optimal has no dispatch section or no declared setpoint variable, or the section drives no storage. | -- |
| <span id="e_distance_unknown"></span>`E_DISTANCE_UNKNOWN` | error | A DISTANCE("a", "b") call names a place with no network node. | -- |
| <span id="e_fleet_arm"></span>`E_FLEET_ARM` | error | A fleet's arm names an unknown motion profile, sits on a worker or gantry fleet or one with loads &gt; 1, or exchange is set without an arm. | [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_field"></span>`E_FLEET_FIELD` | error | A fleet's count, speed, capacity or dispatching rule is missing or malformed. | [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_loads"></span>`E_FLEET_LOADS` | error | A fleet's "loads" is not an integer &gt;= 1, or is above 1 on a worker fleet. | [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_motion"></span>`E_FLEET_MOTION` | error | A fleet's "motion" is not "network"/"gantry", a gantry's speed_x/speed_y/hoist_time is missing or invalid, or a gantry fleet is also kind "worker". | [MOTION](../blocks/motion.md), [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_name"></span>`E_FLEET_NAME` | error | A mover fleet has an empty or duplicate name, or one clashing with a resource. | [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_node"></span>`E_FLEET_NODE` | error | A fleet's home node is not a declared network node. | [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_power"></span>`E_FLEET_POWER` | error | A fleet's "power" is not an object, or one of its values is not a number &gt;= 0. | [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_units"></span>`E_FLEET_UNITS` | error | A fleet's "units" is not a list of named units with skill lists, has duplicate names, or disagrees with its count. | [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_fleet_unknown"></span>`E_FLEET_UNKNOWN` | error | A TRANSPORT block names a fleet the model does not declare. | [TRANSPORT](../blocks/transport.md), [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_investment"></span>`E_INVESTMENT` | error | The investment section is not an object, names an unknown baseline scenario or throughput KPI, or has horizon_years or operating_hours_per_year &lt;= 0, discount_rate &lt; 0 or a margin_per_part that is not a number. | -- |
| <span id="e_motion_payload"></span>`E_MOTION_PAYLOAD` | error | A move's payload_kg is above its profile's payload_max. | [MOTION](../blocks/motion.md) |
| <span id="e_motion_profile"></span>`E_MOTION_PROFILE` | error | A motion profile has an empty/duplicate name, an unknown kind, speed or accel &lt;= 0, a bad payload_max/payload_derate/collaborative_speed, or lacks the collaborative_speed an HRC block needs. | [MOTION](../blocks/motion.md), [`motion_profiles`](../model-file/motion_profiles.md) |
| <span id="e_motion_profile_unknown"></span>`E_MOTION_PROFILE_UNKNOWN` | error | A MOTION block names a motion profile the model does not declare. | [MOTION](../blocks/motion.md), [`motion_profiles`](../model-file/motion_profiles.md) |
| <span id="e_motion_segment"></span>`E_MOTION_SEGMENT` | error | A MOTION segment has an unknown kind or field, no distance/time, or a negative value; or the cycle has no segments. | [MOTION](../blocks/motion.md) |
| <span id="e_motion_zone"></span>`E_MOTION_ZONE` | error | A MOTION block's hrc mode is unknown, or a separation zone names no network node, has radius_m &lt;= 0 or an unknown measure. | [MOTION](../blocks/motion.md), [`zones`](../model-file/zones.md) |
| <span id="e_motion_zone_unknown"></span>`E_MOTION_ZONE_UNKNOWN` | error | A MOTION block's zone names a zone the model does not declare under "zones". | [MOTION](../blocks/motion.md), [`zones`](../model-file/zones.md) |
| <span id="e_network_node"></span>`E_NETWORK_NODE` | error | A network node has an empty or duplicate name, or a non-numeric coordinate. | [`network`](../model-file/network.md) |
| <span id="e_network_node_unknown"></span>`E_NETWORK_NODE_UNKNOWN` | error | A block's "node" param names a node the network does not declare. | [`network`](../model-file/network.md) |
| <span id="e_network_segment"></span>`E_NETWORK_SEGMENT` | error | A segment names an unknown node, joins a node to itself, or has a bad length, speed, capacity or direction. | [`network`](../model-file/network.md) |
| <span id="e_network_shape"></span>`E_NETWORK_SHAPE` | error | The "network" section is not an object, or length_factor is not &gt; 0. | [`network`](../model-file/network.md) |
| <span id="e_network_unreachable"></span>`E_NETWORK_UNREACHABLE` | error | Two places the model travels between are joined by no path. | [`network`](../model-file/network.md) |
| <span id="e_tending"></span>`E_TENDING` | error | A STATION's tending group has a malformed segment, an unknown field, time unit, hrc mode, zone or cobot mode, an hrc mode the arm's profile has no collaborative_speed for, or the station has no node. | [STATION](../blocks/station.md) |
| <span id="e_transport_keep_arm"></span>`E_TRANSPORT_KEEP_ARM` | error | A TRANSPORT keeps its vehicle (keep_vehicle) on a fleet with an arm; a cobot stays with its part through tending instead. | [TRANSPORT](../blocks/transport.md) |
| <span id="e_travel_mode"></span>`E_TRAVEL_MODE` | error | A ROUTE/TRANSPORT travel mode is unknown, or needs a network the model does not declare. | [ROUTE](../blocks/route.md), [TRANSPORT](../blocks/transport.md) |
| <span id="e_worker_fleet"></span>`E_WORKER_FLEET` | error | A SEIZE/PROCESS worker_fleet names no fleet of kind "worker". | [PROCESS](../blocks/process.md), [SEIZE](../blocks/seize.md), [`fleets`](../model-file/fleets.md) |
| <span id="e_worker_no_node"></span>`E_WORKER_NO_NODE` | error | A SEIZE/PROCESS with worker_fleet sits on no network node. | [PROCESS](../blocks/process.md), [SEIZE](../blocks/seize.md) |
| <span id="e_worker_preempt"></span>`E_WORKER_PREEMPT` | error | preempt is set on a block that summons a worker, or that seizes a resource a worker block also seizes. | -- |
| <span id="e_worker_skill_unknown"></span>`E_WORKER_SKILL_UNKNOWN` | error | A worker_skill that no unit of the worker fleet has. | -- |
| <span id="e_worker_when_blocked"></span>`E_WORKER_WHEN_BLOCKED` | error | worker_when_blocked is neither "leaves" nor "stays". | -- |
| <span id="e_zone"></span>`E_ZONE` | error | A zone has an empty or duplicate name, a node that is not a network node, radius_m &lt;= 0, a measure other than path/straight, or an unknown field. | [`zones`](../model-file/zones.md) |
| <span id="w_conveyor_zone"></span>`W_CONVEYOR_ZONE` | warning | A literal leak zone covers no slat (round(start*d) == round(end*d)), so that leak never takes anything. | [CONVEYOR](../blocks/conveyor.md), [`zones`](../model-file/zones.md) |
| <span id="w_dispatch_forecast"></span>`W_DISPATCH_FORECAST` | warning | A forecast flow's rate reads model state (a level, a flow, the bus, a resource), so the plan holds its current rate over the horizon. | -- |
| <span id="w_dispatch_mixed"></span>`W_DISPATCH_MIXED` | warning | A storage on the dispatched bus keeps its own rule; the plan does not see it. | -- |
| <span id="w_investment_no_capex"></span>`W_INVESTMENT_NO_CAPEX` | warning | The model has an investment section and no fixed cost flagged capex, in the model or in a scenario. | -- |
| <span id="w_investment_one_scenario"></span>`W_INVESTMENT_ONE_SCENARIO` | warning | The model has an investment section and no scenario to compare with its baseline. | [`scenarios`](../model-file/scenarios.md) |
| <span id="w_no_charger"></span>`W_NO_CHARGER` | warning | A battery fleet has no reachable charger of the kind its strategy needs. | [`chargers`](../model-file/chargers.md) |
| <span id="w_segment_deadlock_risk"></span>`W_SEGMENT_DEADLOCK_RISK` | warning | A two-way segment of capacity 1 on a network driven by more than one vehicle: two meeting head-on can deadlock. | -- |
| <span id="w_tending_deadlock"></span>`W_TENDING_DEADLOCK` | warning | One cobot both feeds and empties a tending station with no exchange and no finite space before the machine: it can wait loaded for a machine that waits to be emptied. | -- |
| <span id="w_tending_stay"></span>`W_TENDING_STAY` | warning | A station keeps its cobot ("stay") but no TRANSPORT of an arm fleet carries the part on. | [TRANSPORT](../blocks/transport.md) |
| <span id="w_tending_unused"></span>`W_TENDING_UNUSED` | warning | A station declares tending but no fleet has an arm. | -- |
| <span id="w_transport_keep_unfreed"></span>`W_TRANSPORT_KEEP_UNFREED` | warning | Nothing downstream of a TRANSPORT with keep_vehicle frees the vehicle (no RELEASE naming the fleet, no TRANSPORT on it without keep_vehicle): it waits with the part until the part leaves. | [RELEASE](../blocks/release.md), [TRANSPORT](../blocks/transport.md) |
